name: Suphannaphum Kingdom
native: สุพรรณภูมิ

predecessors.name: Dvaravati
predecessors.text: the Tha Chin valley: the page says the kingdom 'straddled the Tha Chin River in a north-south direction' (Suphan Buri, Nakhon Pathom, Chai Nat, Samut Sakhon)

successors.name: Ayutthaya Kingdom
successors.text: the Tha Chin valley: the page says the kingdom 'straddled the Tha Chin River in a north-south direction' (Suphan Buri, Nakhon Pathom, Chai Nat, Samut Sakhon)

ledger.x: c. 1300: Suphannabhum breaks away from Sukhothai. The page says only that 'After Ram Khamhaeng died in 1298, its vassals began to break away'; the year 1300 is bridged from the sukhothai-kingdom dossier's loss ('Suphannaphum Kingdom... left early in Loe Thai's reign').
1351: Suphanburi joins Lopburi, Ayodhya and Phetchaburi in the new Ayutthaya Kingdom.
1351: the Suphannabhum kingdom is absorbed into Ayutthaya.

certainty.note: The page names a river and a moat, not a frontier.
